title: Measurement
description: File: measurements/<contribution>/<submitted_by>.yaml. Result of the A/B bench (bee/bench/ab.py) run on a participant's machine for a contribution, between two precise commits of the fork. It is DATA, not a verdict: it enriches the picture by multiplying configurations, it does not decide acceptance alone (correctness is still judged by the trusted CI). One measurement per human account and per contribution, like a vote. The weight comes from independent reproduction: several configurations that agree, not a single one.

contribution.description: id of the measured contribution (e.g. miniz-0011-c1)

submitted_by.description: login of the participant; must be the file name

base.description: sha of the reference commit (A) compared

candidate.description: sha of the candidate commit (B) compared

tool.description: origin of the tooling (version of bee, or sha of the fork's bee/)

config.description: Description of the machine (taken as is from ab.py: field « machine »).

beyond_noise.description: sign test on the interleaved A/B pairs

pairs.description: unequal pairs (N of the sign test)

reason.description: free remark (observed anomaly, thermal throttling, etc.)
